name: User is one row per user despite its partner and location joins
note: Openitem joins this cube many_to_one. Its SQL LEFT JOINs c_bpartner and c_bpartner_location, but on the USER's own foreign keys, so each resolves to at most one row. Verified 236,427/236,427 before switching direction; this holds it.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ad_user WHERE ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
